text:
Alice (People Ops): Hey team — FYI Sam's paycheck went negative after today's run. Looks like commuter pre-tax deductions from his CA profile followed him after the midyear move to OR. Please advise.

Sam Jones: Oh no, I saw a -$320 on my paystub and bank says deposit bounced. Can someone confirm what's happening? :worried:

Linda (Payroll): Pulling the run logs now. Initial glance: commuter code CB-CA still applied to employee 100345 even though state changed on 2025-06-15.

Payroll Bot: Payroll run completed: job_id=87432, run_ts=1923456700. Off-cycle capabilities available.

Miguel (Benefits): Hmm — we should have auto-deactivated CA commuter when residency moved to OR. I'll check enrollment sync with HRIS.

Erin (Payroll Eng): Can someone drop the employee ID and last 4 so I can search logs? I can patch the deduction rule and queue an off-cycle refund if payroll approves.

Alice (People Ops): ID 100345, last4 4321. Sam, we'll need your bank routing/confirm in DM so we can push reversal.

Sam Jones: DM'd the info. Thanks.

Linda (Payroll): Found the root cause: deduction persisted because the termination date for the commuter benefit was blank in HRIS for the CA enrollment. System defaulted to active. Ticket created PR-4592.

Jordan (Eng Manager): Please prioritize — Sam is on contract and needs the funds for rent.

Miguel (Benefits): We'll update the enrollment to terminated as of 2025-06-15 and mark it as retro-adjust. That will change YTD pretax commuter by $320. Confirming this will affect pretax YTD and may require W-2 correction (if year-end).

Erin (Payroll Eng): I'm scheduling an off-cycle reversal now. Steps I will run: 1) patch deduction rule to ignore commuter CB-CA for employees with current state != CA; 2) create off-cycle credit for net amount; 3) re-run payroll validation.

Linda (Payroll): Off-cycle refund approved by Finance. Amount to refund net: $320. Expected deposit tomorrow morning. We'll also include memo for W-2 handling: if additional pretax changes push taxable wages, we'll track for W-2c evaluation at year-end.

Payroll Bot: Off-cycle job queued: offcycle_id=OC-2025-87432, eta=24h.

Erin (Payroll Eng): Patch applied to rules and off-cycle ticket kicked. I'll monitor logs and post confirmation link once settlement completes.

Linda (Payroll): :white_check_mark: Follow-up: Off-cycle processed and deposited (txn confirmed). PR-4592 updated with details about HRIS enrollment gap and W-2 implications. We'll open a follow-up to decide on W-2c timing if similar cases accumulate.

Alice (People Ops): Thanks everyone — Sam, please confirm receipt and let us know if anything else pops up.

Sam Jones: Got it, deposit hit my account this morning. Appreciate the quick turnaround :pray:

Linda (Payroll): Logged for records: payroll adjustment id ADJ-100345-2025-06. Closing thread once W-2 decision finalized.

Miguel (Benefits): I'll add an automated checklist item to offboard/move flows to ensure commuter enrollments are terminated when state changes.

Alice (People Ops): Perfect — extra step in the move playbook sounds good. Closing for now.
